public.books_with_essay_count.definition: SELECT b.id, b.title_cs, b.title_en, b.author, b.isbn_13, b.description, b.google_books_cover_url, b.book_points, b.page_count, b.preview_link, b.source, b.external_id, b.list_status, b.list_status_changed_at, b.list_status_changed_by_profile_id, b.list_status_reason, b.highlight_category_id, b.is_rocket_model, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.created_by_profile_id, b.updated_by_profile_id, COALESCE(ec.essay_count, 0) AS essay_count FROM books b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT essays.book_id, count(*)::integer AS essay_count FROM essays WHERE essays.book_id IS NOT NULL AND essays.published_at IS NOT NULL AND essays.removed_at IS NULL GROUP BY essays.book_id) ec ON ec.book_id = b.id
